# Mail reference

The mailbox component, drafts and stored mail, the persistence seam and the server-side mail service. For how to use it, see [Mail](../modules/mail.md).

## VtUnitMail

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Mail → VtUnitMail**. Adds [VtUnit](units.md#vtunit) automatically.

A player's mailbox: sends mail with item and currency attachments, reads, takes attachments, deletes and returns mail. Opt in through `VtUnitDefinition.useMail`; needs a `VtPlayerIdentity` on the same object.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `string PlayerId { get; }` | The player id the mailbox belongs to, or empty without an identity. |
| `IReadOnlyList<VtMailMessage> Mailbox { get; }` | This player's mails, newest last: the server's on the authority, the replicated copy on a client. |
| `int UnreadCount { get; }` | Mails not yet read. |
| `event Action<IReadOnlyList<VtMailMessage>> OnMailboxChanged` | Fires when the mailbox changed. |
| `event Action<VtMailMessage> OnMailArrived` | Fires when a mail arrives, including returned mail. |
| `void Initialize()` | Cache siblings and listen to the mail service. Idempotent. |
| `bool Send(VtMailDraft draft, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Send `draft`, taking its attachments and the postage from this unit. |
| `bool TakeAttachments(string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Take a mail's currency and as many of its items as fit. |
| `bool MarkRead(string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Mark a mail read. |
| `bool Delete(string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Delete a mail whose attachments were taken. |
| `bool ReturnToSender(string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Send a player's mail back with its attachments. |
| `void ApplyMailboxFromNet(IEnumerable<VtMailMessage> messages)` | Replace this player's view of its mailbox. Used by replication; not authority-gated. |
| `void ApplyArrivalFromNet(VtMailMessage message)` | Raise `OnMailArrived` on a client. Used by replication; not authority-gated. |

## VtMailDraft

Serializable class.

A mail being written: recipient, subject, body and attachments. Build it with `Create`, `WithItem` and `WithCurrency`, then hand it to `VtUnitMail.Send`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| To (`to`) | `string` | Empty | Recipient by name or player id. Offline players are found through the player directory. |
| Subject (`subject`) | `string` | Empty | Subject line. Must not be empty; capped at Mail Subject Max Length. |
| Body (`body`) | `string` | Empty | Body text. Capped at Mail Body Max Length. |
| Items (`items`) | List of [VtMailItem](#vtmailitem) | Empty | Items to attach, taken from the sender's inventory on send. |
| Currency (`currency`) | List of [VtMailCurrency](#vtmailcurrency) | Empty | Currency to attach, taken from the sender's wallet on send. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static VtMailDraft Create(string to, string subject, string body)` | A draft to a player by name or id. |
| `VtMailDraft WithItem(VtItemDefinition item, int count)` | Attach `count` of `item` from the sender's inventory. |
| `VtMailDraft WithCurrency(VtCurrencyDefinition currencyDefinition, int amount)` | Attach `amount` of `currencyDefinition` from the sender's wallet. |

## VtMailMessage

Serializable class.

One mail in a mailbox. Plain data that serializes with `JsonUtility`; change it only through `VtMail`.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mail Id (`mailId`) | `string` | Empty | Unique id generated on delivery. |
| From Id (`fromId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the sender. Empty for system mail. |
| From Name (`fromName`) | `string` | Empty | Sender name to show. Empty for system mail. |
| To Id (`toId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the mailbox owner. |
| Subject (`subject`) | `string` | Empty | Subject line, cleaned of markup and line breaks. |
| Body (`body`) | `string` | Empty | Body text, cleaned of markup. Keeps line breaks. |
| Sent At (`sentAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the mail arrived, in UTC seconds since 1970. |
| Expires At (`expiresAt`) | `double` | 0 | When the mail expires, in UTC seconds since 1970: Mail Expiry Days after it arrived. |
| Read (`read`) | `bool` | Off | On once the recipient read the mail or took its attachments. |
| Is System (`isSystem`) | `bool` | Off | Sent by the game rather than a player. Cannot be returned. |
| Returned (`returned`) | `bool` | Off | Came back to its sender. Cannot be returned again. |
| Items (`items`) | List of [VtMailItem](#vtmailitem) | Empty | Attached items still waiting to be taken. |
| Currency (`currency`) | List of [VtMailCurrency](#vtmailcurrency) | Empty | Attached currency still waiting to be taken. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool HasAttachments { get; }` | True while items or currency are still attached. |

## VtMailboxSnapshot

Serializable class.

A mailbox as one JSON-friendly object, for stores and replication.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Player Id (`playerId`) | `string` | Empty | Player id of the mailbox owner. |

## IVtMailStore

Interface. Implemented by [VtJsonMailStore](#vtjsonmailstore), `VtMemoryMailStore`.

Where mailboxes persist, one per player. `VtMail` loads a mailbox the first time it is needed and saves after every change, so an implementation may write asynchronously. An online game implements this against its database.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `List<VtMailMessage> LoadMailbox(string playerId)` | The stored mails for `playerId`; empty when there are none. |
| `void SaveMailbox(string playerId, List<VtMailMessage> messages)` | Persist `playerId`'s mails. |

## VtJsonMailStore

Class.

Stores each player's mailbox as a JSON file in a folder.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `List<VtMailMessage> LoadMailbox(string playerId)` | The mails in the player's file; empty when the file does not exist. |
| `void SaveMailbox(string playerId, List<VtMailMessage> messages)` | Write the player's mails to their JSON file, creating the folder when needed. |

## VtMail

Static class.

The mail service. Runs on the authority: delivers mail to online or offline players, lets recipients read, take attachments, delete and return mail, expires old mail, and persists mailboxes through `Store`. Players send through `VtUnitMail`, which takes the attached items, currency and postage from the sender first. Server code sends rewards and notices with `SendSystem`.

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IVtMailStore Store { get; set; }` | Where mailboxes persist. Setting it clears the cache. |
| `static Func<double> Clock { get; set; }` | Wall-clock seconds for send and expiry times. Null restores UTC time. |
| `static event Action<string, IReadOnlyList<VtMailMessage>> OnMailboxChanged` | Fires after a mailbox changed: (player id, mails). |
| `static event Action<string, VtMailMessage> OnMailArrived` | Fires when a mail lands in a mailbox, including returns: (player id, mail). |
| `static VtDefinitionCatalog Catalog` | Resolves attachment ids. Null uses `VtDefinitionCatalog.Instance`. |
| `static IReadOnlyList<VtMailMessage> GetMailbox(string playerId)` | The mails for `playerId`, newest last, with expired mail handled. |
| `static VtMailMessage Find(string playerId, string mailId)` | The mail with `mailId` in `playerId`'s mailbox, or null. |
| `static int UnreadCount(string playerId)` | Unread mails for `playerId`. |
| `static bool CanSend(string fromId, VtMailDraft draft, out VtPlayerRecord recipient, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Check everything about a player's draft except the sender's items and money, and clean its subject and body in place. |
| `static VtMailMessage Deliver(string fromId, string fromName, string toPlayerId, VtMailDraft draft, bool isSystem)` | Put a checked draft in the recipient's mailbox. `VtUnitMail` calls this after taking the attachments from the sender; call it yourself only with attachments already paid for. |
| `static VtMailMessage SendSystem(string toPlayerId, string subject, string body, VtMailDraft attachments = null)` | Send a mail from the game, such as a reward that did not fit or a notice. Ignores the mailbox cap and needs no directory entry. Attachments are created, not taken from anyone. |
| `static bool MarkRead(string playerId, string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Mark a mail read. |
| `static bool Delete(string playerId, string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Delete a mail without attachments. |
| `static bool TakeAttachments(string playerId, string mailId, VtUnitInventory inventory, VtUnitWallet wallet, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Move a mail's currency into `wallet` and its items into `inventory` until one does not fit. Also marks it read. |
| `static bool ReturnToSender(string playerId, string mailId, out VtMailFailureReason reason)` | Send a player's mail back to its sender with its attachments. |
| `static void ResetState()` | Forget cached mailboxes and seams, and return to an empty in-memory store. |

## Enums

### VtMailFailureReason

Why a mail call refused.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The call succeeded. |
| `NoIdentity` | The player has no player identity. |
| `RecipientNotFound` | No known player by that name or id. |
| `CannotMailSelf` | A player cannot mail itself. |
| `RecipientMailboxFull` | The recipient has `VtTuning.mailboxMaxCount` mails. |
| `SubjectEmpty` | The subject is empty after cleaning. |
| `TooLong` | The subject or body is longer than allowed. |
| `TooManyAttachments` | More attachment lines than `VtTuning.mailMaxAttachments`. |
| `UnknownDefinition` | An attached item or currency id is not in the Definition Catalog. |
| `NoInventory` | The sender has no inventory for item attachments. |
| `MissingItems` | The sender holds fewer items than attached. |
| `ItemNotTradeable` | An attached item cannot be traded. |
| `NoWallet` | The sender has no wallet for currency or postage. |
| `CannotAfford` | The sender cannot pay the attached currency plus postage. |
| `MailNotFound` | No mail with that id in the mailbox. |
| `AttachmentsRemaining` | Take the attachments before deleting. |
| `InventoryFull` | Some attached items did not fit; the rest stay attached. |
| `NotReturnable` | System mail and returned mail cannot be returned. |
| `AuthorityNotLocal` | Not the authority; the request was forwarded. |
